webgpu.note: WebGPU requires fp32 for clean audio

notes: Mirror onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX to https://models.tryjunco.com/kokoro-web/v1/{model}/ with CORS for https://read.tryjunco.com and localhost. The app picks WebGPU+fp32 when available (faster), else WASM+q8. Synthesis runs in a Web Worker; playback schedules chunks back-to-back on the AudioContext clock, buffering ~30s of audio ahead.
